# weather-cli

Prints the current temperature for your city.

    npx weather-cli

Set your city in `~/.config/weather-cli/config.json`:

    {"city": "Warsaw"}

The CLI sends only the city name to the free Open-Meteo API (https://open-meteo.com) to look up the forecast. It needs no account or API key and stores nothing.

This fixture is synthetic test data for NoBrainer Security.
